notes.title: Trading cards, Badges, Emoji and Background Profile are released
notes.content:
[h1][b]Finaly, Trading cards, Badges, Emoji and Background Profile of H-Rescue are release[/b][/h1]
After a long time waiting, trading cards were finally approved

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35824427/52b9f0a5f98c3fa98d81af15a60fbb69d6a2e0f0.png[/img]

Besides Trading Card, Badges, Emoji and Background Profile are also ready to wait for dear players to collect

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35824427/f9d68220af37c4c558b1ba005c671907ac960e10.png[/img]

Thanks for playing and have a nice day ♥

notes.title: NEW UPDATE FOR H-Rescue
notes.content:
After a period of game launch, we have made a few updates:

- Add a choice to the end of the game. Now you can save Miraha by leaving a space for her to choose who will be saved.
- Fix some minor bugs in the game.
- Fix some errors related to achievements.
- Add loading screen.

Thank you for supporting us so far.
Happy gaming ♥♥♥
